headcrab.name: headcrab

props.attack_text: leaps at your face and bites

headcrab.description: A fleshy, beaked Xen parasite that latches onto heads. You know what happens next.
headcrab.appearance: A headcrab scuttles across the floor, then rears up, ready to leap.

baby_headcrab.name: baby headcrab

props.attack_text: nips at your ankles

baby_headcrab.description: A tiny headcrab, fresh from the Gonarch.
baby_headcrab.appearance: Baby headcrabs swarm over the ground.

zombie.name: zombie

props.attack_text: rakes you with its claws
props.death_text: The zombie collapses. The headcrab twitches once and is still.

zombie.description: A scientist with a headcrab clamped over his head, his ribcage split open into a second mouth. He groans for help.
zombie.appearance: A zombie in a torn lab coat staggers toward you, moaning.

houndeye.name: houndeye

props.attack_text: lets loose a shrieking sonic blast at

houndeye.description: A three-legged Xen pack animal with one great eye and a sonic attack. They hunt in packs and chirp to each other.
houndeye.appearance: A houndeye blinks at you with its single huge eye, warbling a warning.

bullsquid.name: bullsquid

props.attack_text: spits burning acid at

bullsquid.description: A squat, tentacle-mouthed predator that lurks near water and spits acid. It hates headcrabs almost as much as it hates you.
bullsquid.appearance: A bullsquid lurches toward you, mouth-tentacles writhing.

vortigaunt.name: vortigaunt

props.attack_text: hurls a crackling green bolt of lightning at

vortigaunt.description: A hunched, one-eyed alien with a collar of shackles, channelling green electricity through its claws. It murmurs in a language you don't know.
vortigaunt.appearance: A vortigaunt warps in with a crackle of green light, arms already charging.

alien_grunt.name: alien grunt

props.attack_text: fires a stream of homing hornets at

alien_grunt.description: A hulking, armoured Xen soldier with a living hivehand bolted to its arm.
alien_grunt.appearance: An alien grunt lumbers forward, its hivehand buzzing.

controller.name: alien controller

props.attack_text: hurls glowing energy balls at

controller.description: A floating, foetal-looking alien with a huge head, psychic and hateful.
controller.appearance: An alien controller drifts overhead, its swollen head glowing.

ichthyosaur.name: ichthyosaur

props.attack_text: lunges out of the water and bites

ichthyosaur.description: A huge eel-like aquatic predator with too many teeth and a fondness for anything that swims.
ichthyosaur.appearance: Something huge circles in the water. An ichthyosaur breaks the surface, jaws gaping.

leech.name: leech

props.attack_text: fastens onto your leg and sucks

leech.description: A small Xen leech that lives in dark water.
leech.appearance: Leeches flicker in the dark water.

snark.name: snark

props.attack_text: chitters and bites

snark.description: A small, red, beetle-like Xen creature that explodes when it has done enough biting.
snark.appearance: A snark scuttles toward you, chittering.

gargantua.name: gargantua

props.attack_text: sweeps a gout of flame over
props.death_text: The gargantua staggers, its armour cracking with light, and explodes in a shower of gore.

gargantua.description: A towering, armoured Xen colossus that breathes fire from its forearms and stomps anything smaller than a tank.
gargantua.appearance: A gargantua towers here, its eye glowing, flame-throwers flaring on its arms.

gonarch.name: Gonarch

props.attack_text: slams a bony leg into
props.death_text: The Gonarch shrieks, bursts, and falls in on itself.

gonarch.description: The adult form of the headcrab: a huge armoured sac on four long legs, spawning babies as it hunts.
gonarch.appearance: The Gonarch rears up on its four legs, its swollen sac pulsing.

nihilanth.name: Nihilanth

props.attack_text: hurls a storm of electric spheres at
props.death_text: The Nihilanth's skull splits open with light. It screams across every dimension at once.

nihilanth.description: A colossal floating foetus with a vast cranium and withered arms, crowned by healing crystals. Its voice fills your skull.
nihilanth.appearance: The Nihilanth hangs in the air at the heart of the chamber, enormous, its voice echoing in your head.

tentacle.name: tentacles

appearance.text: Charred stumps of the tentacles hang slack in the silo.
Three gigantic tentacles rise from the silo floor, beaked tips probing for sound.

tentacle.description: They are blind, and hunt by sound. Their beaks punch through steel.

do: They're already burned to a crisp.
You might as well shoot a building. The tentacles shrug it off and slam toward the sound.

hecu_marine.name: HECU marine

props.attack_text: opens fire on

hecu_marine.description: A Hazardous Environment Combat Unit marine in a gas mask and fatigues, sent to clean up the incident. Including witnesses.
hecu_marine.appearance: A HECU marine shouts to his squad and opens fire.

sentry_gun.name: sentry gun

props.attack_text: sprays bullets at
props.death_text: The sentry gun sparks and topples over.

sentry_gun.description: An automated tripod gun with a motion sensor and a short temper.
sentry_gun.appearance: A sentry gun swivels toward you, beeping.

apache.name: Apache helicopter

props.attack_text: strafes
props.death_text: The Apache shudders, trails black smoke and plunges out of sight into the canyon.

apache.description: An AH-64 Apache helicopter gunship, rotor thumping, nose gun tracking.
apache.appearance: An Apache helicopter thunders overhead, nose gun swinging toward you.

female_assassin.name: black ops assassin

props.attack_text: flips past you and fires a silenced pistol at

female_assassin.description: A Black Ops agent in a black catsuit and night-vision goggles, silent and acrobatic.
female_assassin.appearance: A black-clad assassin drops from the shadows, silenced pistol raised.

male_assassin.name: black ops operative

props.attack_text: fires a burst at

male_assassin.description: A Black Ops operative in a balaclava and night-vision goggles, armed with an MP5 or a sniper rifle.
male_assassin.appearance: A Black Ops operative signals to his team and opens fire.

zombie_guard.name: zombie security guard

props.attack_text: claws at

zombie_guard.description: A security guard taken by a headcrab, kevlar vest and all.
zombie_guard.appearance: A zombie in a security uniform shambles toward you.

zombie_soldier.name: zombie soldier

props.attack_text: lashes out at

zombie_soldier.description: A HECU marine taken by a headcrab, gas mask still on under it.
zombie_soldier.appearance: A zombified marine lurches toward you.

gonome.name: gonome

props.attack_text: hurls a gob of bile at

gonome.description: What a headcrab zombie becomes when left long enough: the headcrab fused into the host, a gaping chest maw full of teeth.
gonome.appearance: A gonome lurches out of the dark, its chest-maw gaping.

pit_drone.name: pit drone

props.attack_text: fires a volley of spikes at

pit_drone.description: A Race X creature with a head full of spikes it can shoot.
pit_drone.appearance: A pit drone skitters toward you, head-spikes quivering.

shock_trooper.name: shock trooper

props.attack_text: fires its shock roach at

shock_trooper.description: A tall Race X soldier carrying a living shock roach as a weapon. Its single eye glows.
shock_trooper.appearance: A shock trooper warps in with a crackle, shock roach raised.

voltigore.name: voltigore

props.attack_text: hurls a ball of purple lightning at
props.death_text: The voltigore crackles, swells and explodes in a burst of purple light.

voltigore.description: A huge Race X beast with a mouth full of electricity. When it dies, it explodes.
voltigore.appearance: A voltigore crashes through, purple lightning crackling between its jaws.

baby_voltigore.name: baby voltigore

props.attack_text: snaps at

baby_voltigore.appearance: A baby voltigore scrabbles toward you.

pit_worm.name: pit worm

props.attack_text: lashes out with its laser-eye at
props.death_text: The pit worm sinks screaming into the sludge.

pit_worm.description: A vast Race X worm that lives in deep water, with an eye that projects a cutting beam.
pit_worm.appearance: The pit worm rises from the waste water, its eye blazing.

gene_worm.name: Gene Worm

props.attack_text: sprays a torrent of corrosive toxin over
props.death_text: The Gene Worm convulses, collapses into the portal and is torn apart as the rift closes.

gene_worm.description: A colossal Race X bio-engineer that converts whatever world it reaches into a habitat for its kind. It came through a portal, and it has eyes the size of cars.
gene_worm.appearance: The Gene Worm fills the portal, vast and slick, its armoured eyes swivelling.
